openvino_telemetry.turn_off: on by default: ledger_room/__init__.py sets CI=true before openvino is imported; opt_in_out --opt_out also writes 0 to the per-user consent file

phases_watched: imports (openvino), model load, OCR + model reads (cache off), rules, evidence crops, audit log, CSV export
verdict: PASS: no connection or lookup to a non-local address
limits: Sampling can miss a native connection shorter than the interval; the audit hook sees Python-level socket calls only. Network adapters were up during the run. Not a replacement for a run with the network adapter disabled.
